answers.expected_answer: Shuffle region cards; reveal top for King, each player takes another for home and places Grande. Two Caballeros home, one on first success-track space, seven court; remaining supply provinces.
Players choose first-round starter; previous round’s last player begins later rounds; clockwise; no duplicate value in a round.
Descending power value determines turns. Recruit at most pictured Caballeros from provinces into court first, then choose face-up action card.
May remove own Caballeros from board to make up difference; not King’s region or Castillo (taboo and no Castillo removal outside general scoring).
From court to regions adjacent to current King and/or Castillo; split freely; printed number is maximum, fewer allowed.
Either order, each completed wholly before next; no splitting/interleaving. Special action optional, may select card to prevent it.
Chosen card laid aside unavailable to later players; remaining face-up cards discarded at round end; King card returns face-up every round, never permanently discarded.
No Caballeros, Grande or mobile scoreboard in/out, even special actions; scoring allowed. King-moving actions move King, changing which region is taboo.
Announce number added; entry whenever adding/moving Caballeros regardless King; leave only at general scoring.
After rounds 3,6,9: secretly choose destinations first and place disks face down; uncover and score Castillo; reveal disks and move its Caballeros; score board regions in track order.
All must go to single disk-selected region, not King’s region; Castillo emptied. Illegal King choice sends own Castillo Caballeros to own court.

6,4,0,0: tied third players drop to fourth.

Uncover and score; replace Castillo over same Caballeros; no redistribution until general scoring.

Any one played card, including current turn’s, to hand; need not reveal, though taking visible top is observable.
After third general scoring following round9; furthest along success track/most points wins.
Separate stacks by backs1–5, shuffle each separately face down (eleven each in1–4, sole King in5). Reveal top of each, five total. Marker starts space1; advance one each later round.
